title: Dialogue: player on the left, the other person on the right
caption: In conversations the player (Eric or Carina) now stands on the left facing right and the other person on the right facing left, both turned towards the text. Portraits drawn facing the other way are mirrored.

sections.title: Eric with each person, desktop
sections.caption: Eric on the left, the other speaker on the right. Eric, Kuro and the guard are mirrored so they face the text.

sections.title: Eric with each person, phone
sections.caption: On a phone only the speaker shows, on their own side.

sections.title: Three people
sections.caption: One slot each side: whoever spoke last besides the player holds the right.

sections.title: Carina as the player
sections.caption: Carina takes the left the same way, mirrored to face right.
